versions.changelog:
- Added instructions for a visual setup wizard on the dashboard for easier configuration.
- Installation section now highlights in-dashboard setup: generate a node ID, test the relay connection, and export your config from one place.
- Manual configuration instructions remain available as an alternative.
- No changes to security, configuration, or protocol details.

Initial release of remote-relay.

- Provides secure, outbound-only relay for remote OpenClaw control via WebSocket—no open ports, SSH, or Telegram/Discord required.
- Supports remote prompt execution, workflow triggering, health reporting, and safe restarts through declared capabilities.
- Authenticates each node using environment variables: RELAY_URL, NODE_ID, and AUTH_TOKEN.
- All network communication is outbound, TLS-encrypted, and scoped to the configured relay server.
- Local model execution and system privacy are maintained; only minimal status and response data are sent.
